spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

---

**¶2:** Consider the Divine calling, which proceeded from the Lord as operative Divine Truth in the beginning. He directed it toward the interior celestial will — the primordial human good that had descended into states of temptation. It is a communication of heavenly peace and of conjunction, a doctrine He inscribed and sent to the one conjoined with Him by mutual spiritual love, in which all the truths of Divine Providence are set forth, together with everything that calling will accomplish and bring into spiritual order. That Divine calling, the interior celestial will [GAP-1: ... is appointed to receive and undergo.]

---

**¶3:** The reciprocal acknowledgment that ascended from the interior celestial will came upward into interior and celestial states, to the Lord as operative Divine Truth. That also is a communication of interior states, which was sent from the primordial human good to the Lord, in which all the truths of its experience are set forth — every spiritual temptation and every combat it had endured against evils and falsities. It did [GAP-2: ...] in that reciprocal acknowledgment that the interior celestial will [GAP-3: ... ...] everything that had been suffered inwardly and everything [GAP-4: REVIEW that was foreseen to come], all that had been accomplished through temptation-combats and whatever remains prepared to be accomplished through it. The Lord as operative Divine Truth thereby knew all the temptations and the spiritual perils and the contests that the ruling evils and falsities of the lower nature had waged against the primordial human good.

---

### Notes on the Gaps

- **GAP-1** requires something expressing the spiritual destiny or ordination of the celestial will in relation to the Divine calling — that it is appointed to undergo all that Providence has inscribed.
- **GAP-2** appears to need a verb of disclosure or manifestation — the interior will *revealed* or *set forth openly* its states.
- **GAP-3** likely carried a verb of recounting or confessing — the celestial will *declared* or *laid open* before the Divine.
- **GAP-4** (marked REVIEW) spiritually demands foresight: truths concerning what Providence has ordained still to unfold through further temptation-states.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Consider the summons, which was sent from the Living Spirit in the beginning. He sent it to the First Man. It is a peace letter and greeting that he wrote and sent to his brother, in which all the tidings are written down, together with everything it will bring about and establish by that summons. That summons, the First Man [received, and all within it]

The answer that was sent from the First Man came to the heights, to the Living Spirit. That is also a letter, which was sent from the First Man to the Living Spirit, in which all the tidings are written down; and every war and the struggles that he had waged. It did [become manifest] in the answer that the First Man [had set forth and written down] everything that had happened and everything [that would happen], all that had been done and whatever is made ready to be done by him. The Living Spirit knew all the wars and the dangers and the contests that the rulers had waged against the First Man.

fills.explanation: The First Man receives the summons (the celestial will receives the Divine calling), and everything inscribed in it — all that Providence has ordained — is destined to come to pass, matching the spiritual reading's "appointed to receive and undergo."

The spiritual reading requires a verb of disclosure or manifestation — the interior states became openly revealed in the reciprocal acknowledgment, fitting the Kephalaia's register of cosmic disclosure.

fills.fill: had set forth and written down
fills.explanation: The spiritual reading requires a verb of declaring/laying open, and the earlier parallel ("all the tidings are written down") strongly constrains the vocabulary to writing and setting forth, describing the celestial will's full disclosure of its temptation-states.

The editor's choice is confirmed: the parallel structure ("everything that had happened / everything that would happen" mirroring "all that had been done / whatever is made ready to be done") and the spiritual sense of Providential foresight both support "that would happen."
